title: Polydoxon Transformations and Scientific Reward in Physics
summary: We develop a descriptive account of scientific reward in physics based on the concept of the time-dependent Polydoxon, defined as the structured set of empirically viable theories at a given time. We argue that highly rewarded contributions, such as those recognized by major prizes and professional honors, can be systematically understood as those that transform this space. These transformations take the form of expansion (adding viable theories), contraction (eliminating viable theories), reconfiguration (illuminating deeper structures and relations within and between theories), and…
